test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, each with a different height, B is taller than D but shorter than E. C is shorter than E. A is taller than F. D and E are shorter than C and A, respectively. E is shorter than A and F. Who among the six friends is the tallest?
solution: Given → Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, each of different height. 1) B is taller than D but shorter than E. • **E > B > D** 2) E is shorter than A and F. • A, F > E > B > D 3) A is taller than F •
